title: Good throughput benchmark with b.SetBytes — reports MB/s
expected_feedback: no violations; uses b.SetBytes for MB/s output, b.Loop handles the timer so no ResetTimer is needed, and the error is checked with b.Fatal rather than parked in a sink — an ignored error would mean benchmarking the cheap failure path
note: Sinking the error was never what kept the call alive — a store to sinkBytes is already observable. Checking it is what stops a silently-failing benchmark from looking fast.
